rv.q: We came to see Whishaw, who's always reliably brilliant on a stage as he is here, but left bowled over by an age-defying performance from the formidable Kathryn Hunter.
On those terms it's satisfying because the stars absolutely deliver like you'd hope they would

cn.t: Eurotrash earns mostly positive notices, with Ben Whishaw and Kathryn Hunter delivering standout performances in this eccentric Young Vic production. An unconventional but largely rewarding theatrical experience.
